profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a public company incorporated under Amazon (ticker: AMZN, CIK 0001018724), founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, WA. AWS reported revenue of $716,924,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025. The company's website focuses on Amazon SageMaker, which AWS describes as "the center for all your data, analytics, and AI," offering an integrated environment for machine learning, analytics, and generative AI development.

Amazon SageMaker is tracked as an AWS product covering the full ML lifecycle, including model monitoring, bias detection, and explainability tools. The platform includes SageMaker Unified Studio, a managed development environment that brings together tools for model development, data processing, SQL analytics, and generative AI application building. The site also highlights components such as HyperPod, JumpStart, MLOps tooling, Amazon SageMaker Catalog for access governance, and Amazon Q Developer as an AI assistant for software development tasks including model building, SQL generation, and data pipeline creation. AWS Bedrock is separately tracked as a managed foundation model API service with IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and AgentCore for agent orchestration.

The held facts record no litigation and no MCP server presence for AWS. The company maintains a profile page on theworldofai.org, verified on August 21, 2026.
